raw_response: {"diagnosis":"The 30 duplicate txn_ids are the 30 rows with record_version=2, which are re-deliveries or corrections of rows already loaded at version 1. silver_transactions has no dedup, so both versions pass through. The fix keeps only the latest version per txn_id, ordered by record_version and then ingest_ts. It applies that before the POSTED filter, so a version 2 row that is REVERSED correctly removes the transaction.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.82,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
